goal: When a customer whisper is question-like but the existing SummonScout parser cannot resolve it, reply with currently available summon destinations; when the customer selects a recognized destination, keep local requests on the current summoner and hand remote requests through the configured master to a live summoner serving that destination.
notes: Lua-only hot modules. Normal understood whisper requests stay on the existing core path. Fleet control payloads use a dedicated SSFR1 prefix with hex-encoded fields to avoid colliding with the direct-prefix buyer parser and avoid literal WoW pipe escapes. Live providers expire by TTL; remote routes ACK back before the origin confirms success. No Ritual/native coordinator/payment/World-chat behavior is replaced. Exact CI/test/artifact evidence will be recorded only after it exists.
